title.value: Population Genomics Approaches for Genetic Characterization of SARS-CoV-2 Lineages
title.justification: The paper focuses on the application of population genomics techniques to analyze the genetic diversity and evolutionary dynamics of SARS-CoV-2 lineages during the COVID-19 pandemic.
title.quote: Title: Population Genomics Approaches for Genetic Characterization of SARS-CoV-2 Lineages

extractions.description: This paper presents a set of genomic surveillance tools from population genetics for understanding the evolution of SARS-CoV-2, the virus causing COVID-19. It details methods like haplotype networks and principal component analysis for real-time lineage identification and analyzes 329,854 sequences from the GISAID database to demonstrate these approaches. The study aims to enhance viral genetic profiling and surveillance, aiding in tracing infection pathways and designing preventive strategies during the pandemic.

primary_category.justification: The paper aims to enhance understanding of SARS-CoV-2 evolution using genomic data, which aligns with the advancement of scientific methods to monitor and predict biological phenomena affecting public health, akin to climate science methodologies but in the context of viral spread rather than environmental systems.
primary_category.quote: The objective is to present genomic surveillance tools from population genetics to better understand the evolution of the virus in humans.
